# github.com/circleci-functions/setup-docker

Build and push images.

**Version:** v0.2.0
**Latest:** v0.2.0

## Arguments
| Argument | Type   | Default | Description |
| -------- | ------ | ------- | ----------- |
| tag      | string |         |             |

## Outputs
| Output     | Type   | Secret | Description                  |
| ---------- | ------ | ------ | ---------------------------- |
| digest     | string | yes    | Digest of the pushed image.  |
| image-refs | list   | no     | Each image reference pushed. |
| pushed     | bool   | no     |                              |

## Published versions
| Version |
| ------- |
| v0.2.0  |
